newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Bank of Cyprus offers rate derivatives.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Cyprus offers rate derivatives.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus has launched interest rate derivatives to Cypriot corporations that borrow or invest in large amounts of foreign currency, the bank said on Thursday.
"We are beginning to offer the products as from today," said Chris Patsalides, manager of the Financial Management Department at the Bank of Cyprus.
Through the use of interest rate derivatives companies that borrow or invest in large amounts of foreign currency can choose the form of interest rate as well as the band in which it moves.
The bank is offering fixed interest rates and interest rate options which are divided into three categories: the interest rate cap, floor, and collar.

The introduction of interest rate derivatives is the outcome of an increasing demand for foreign borrowing by Cypriot firms, a rise in foreign currency deposits by non-residents, and the expected further liberalisation of the financial sector, the bank said.

The newly-created financial management department at the bank provides advisory services on financial risks and can inform clients on developments in international markets and the forthcoming liberalisation of the Cyprus financial sector, a bank press release said.
